title: Metric Value Distribution Outliers
dataSources: Monte Carlo incident webhooks (`montecarlo:incident`), Great Expectations `validation_result` JSON (`great_expectations:validation`), Soda scan results (`soda:scan`), dbt test failures, warehouse `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` freshness/volume probes via DB Connect.
app: Monte Carlo / Bigeye / Soda webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Great Expectations and dbt test results via HEC scripted inputs; custom warehouse data-quality probes via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=dbx:metric_probe
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(metric_value) as daily_avg by metric_name, _time
| eventstats avg(daily_avg) as base_avg, stdev(daily_avg) as base_sd by metric_name
| eval z=round((daily_avg-base_avg)/base_sd,2)
| where abs(z)>3
| sort - _time
description: Baselines key business-metric values sampled from the warehouse and flags days where a metric deviates sharply from its norm, catching data errors that pass structural checks.
value: Structurally valid data can still be wrong; distribution monitoring catches the day revenue or order counts look impossible before the number reaches the board.
implementation: Sample metric values via DB Connect; schedule daily; tune the z-score; alert and involve the metric owner on anomalies.
visualization: Table of metric outliers, metric-value trend with bands.
grandmaExplanation: We learn what your key numbers normally look like and flag the days they look impossible, catching errors before they reach leadership.
